sources.scope: Lichens and bryophytes combined, process-based model
sources.use: Not a bryophyte-only estimate. Weighting alternatives are not confidence bounds; no automatic insertion into plant weights

sources.scope: 413 subtropical forest sites in Sichuan, China
sources.use: Regional measurements only; cannot extrapolate as a fixed global percentage

sources.scope: Global vegetation simulation, nine plant functional types
sources.use: Potential modeled tree/shrub/grass partition; no global group carbon totals extracted. Coverage fractions must not be treated as biomass fractions

sources.scope: Arctic aboveground plant biomass by functional type
sources.use: Regional and aboveground only, not global whole-plant partition
